limits: Supplemental normal-window diagnostic, not the official smoke substitute or production acceptance.
Scripted 1280x720 scenario named in checks; not human input, multiplayer, sustained 1080p performance or final stripped release acceptance.
Whole-process CPU and nested inclusive phase elapsed are not FPS or GPU timing.
Opt-in frame observations measure Unity updates and assigned-camera callbacks; callback elapsed is not GPU completion or presented FPS.
Unity bootstrap executable hash alone does not identify game content; game assemblies and top-level data payloads are separately hashed.
